claim_boundary: GLOBAL_MAXIMUM_BLOCKED_TOKEN_ORBIT_FOUND refutes the fixed-core orbit theorem inside the imposed cyclic pair-Hall cell after exact replay. UNSAT proves only that pair-Hall subcell. Hall-insertable metadata describes each cut's discovery valuation, not every valuation satisfying that cut. Other statuses are not verdicts.
global_cut_semantics: Every stored cut is eligibility(state) implies theta(state) <= theta(base). Completion metadata is not part of the cut formula.
meaning: Exact CEGAR for a positive canonical four-pair base with unique owner minima. Global cuts enforce normalized-threshold maximality; completion cuts adversarially block exact EFX matchings inside the fixed five-token orbit.

orbit_audit.meaning: Exact rational audit of every permutation of four selected owner minima and one floater over four fixed cores.
